issues.description: The exercise specification (problem statement + UML) requires a method `addGuestStudents(int, String)` (number of new guest students plus a reason), but the reference solution implements `addGuestStudents(int)` with only one parameter. Students following the specification will implement a two-parameter method that does not match the solution (and likely the hidden tests), causing compilation/test failures due to the mismatched method signature.
issues.suggestedFix: Make all artifacts consistent. Preferred: change the solution (and expected API) to `public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents, String reason)` and update the implementation to still increase `numberOfGuestStudents` (the reason can be ignored, logged, or stored). Alternatively, update the problem statement/UML and tests to require only `addGuestStudents(int)`.
